title: Prepare Parse-object initialization and connection linkage

scope.rationale: sqlite3ParseObjectInit clears exactly the recursive Parse header and non-recursive tail, preserves Lemon recursive middle state, links the Parse as the connection head, and publishes an existing connection OOM into the new parser.

external_source_responsibilities: Pinned Parse header/recursive/tail offsets and parse-error publication semantics
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete initialization body is assigned. Prepare entry and Parse reset integration remain open.

inputs: Bulk Parse storage and connection whose current pParse is not that storage
outputs: Zeroed header/tail, preserved recursive middle, outer-parse link, connection-head link, database link, and existing-OOM parser error
contracts.ownership: Parse storage and connection are borrowed; no allocation is introduced by initialization.
contracts.state_and_results: PARSE_HDR starts at zErrMsg and excludes aTempReg; PARSE_TAIL starts at sLastToken. Existing db.pParse becomes pOuterParse before replacement.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns connection serialization. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Existing mallocFailed publishes one parser error and error code while retaining safe linked state.

representation_differences: The Zig owner uses generated Parse byte offsets and slices instead of PARSE_HDR/PARSE_TAIL pointer macros.
With mallocFailed already set, native code publishes the resulting parser error fields directly rather than attempting an unavailable message allocation.

oracle.protocol: Fill Parse storage with a nonzero pattern, seed recursive middle fields and an outer Parse, initialize, and compare cleared ranges, preserved fields, links, and existing-OOM result fields.
oracle.normalization: Pointer addresses are compared only by identity; generated byte-range boundaries and scalar fields are exact. Pinned-C trace remains pending.

assurance.oom: Existing mallocFailed branch is unit-traced; broader prepare OOM continuation remains pending.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; connection serialization remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Aliasing db.pParse violates the source assertion.
assurance.continuation: Initialized Parse is linked and suitable for prepare/reset continuation.
assurance.performance: Two bounded memset operations and constant-time linkage.

integration.native_call_path: The owner is compile- and unit-traced; source-shaped prepare entry dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires prepare/reset integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate with source-shaped UTF-8/UTF-16 prepare entry.
